fn main() {
    let total = int_to_str(1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5)
    print(total)
    drop total
}

fn int_to_str(n: Int) -> Str {
    if n < 10 {
        return str_len("0") + str_len(int_to_str(n))
    } else {
        let rem = n % 10
        let div = n / 10
        return str_len(int_to_str(div)) + str_len(int_to_str(rem))
    }
}

fn str_len(s: Str) -> Int {
    let mut len = 0
    for _ in &s {
        len = len + 1
    }
    len
}

fn print(s: Str) {
    for c in &s {
        print_str(c)
    }
    print_str("\n")
}

fn print_str(s: Str) {
    for c in &s {
        if c >= &str_len && c <= &str_len {
            print_str(".")
        } else if c >= &str_len && c <= &str_len {
            print_str(".")
        } else if c >= &str_len && c <= &str_len {
            print_str(".")
        } else {
            print_str(".")
        }
    }
}

fn push(v: Vec<Int>, x: Int) -> Vec<Int> {
    let mut v = v
    v.push(x)
    v
}

fn clone(x: &Int) -> Int {
    let mut y = 0
    y = y + x
    y
}

fn len(v: &Vec<Int>) -> Int {
    let mut len = 0
    for _ in &v {
        len = len + 1
    }
    len
}

fn get(v: &Vec<Int>, i: Int) -> Option<Int> {
    if i < len(v) {
        return Some(v.get(i))
    } else {
        return None
    }
}
